title: verbena hastata f. rosea
intro: Verbena hastata f. rosea, commonly known as Sweet Veronica or Rose Verbena, is a perennial herb native to North America, belonging to the Verbena family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat various health issues, including anxiety, insomnia, and digestive problems. The health benefits of Verbena hastata f. rosea include its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and sedative properties, which can help to calm the nervous system and relieve muscle tension. The bioactive constituents of this plant include volatile oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
